title: Flesh to Leather
description: This is a Data Pack for Minecraft Java 1.21.11 that will convert Rotten Flesh in to Leather.
body:
**What is it?**
Can't obtain Leather naturally? Enjoy killing Zombies? Great! This is yet another Rotten Flesh to Leather smelting recipe Datapack! **What do I do?**
1. Get Rotten Flesh 2. Put it in a Furnace 3. Add a Fuel source 4. Profit! **How do I install it?**
[Minecraft Wiki Tutorial](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tutorial:Importing_a_data_pack) **Can I see an example?**
Sure! Go to the Gallery section.
